docs.text: What to do on a rainy day by the Great Lakes?
Saying goodbye to Lake Superior/Michigan/Huron and heading down to Erie today! Gonna touch all five Great Lakes on this trip 🦙💜💦
Internet friends! Come visit me! I know lots of good spots to visit. You can see two Great Lakes for the price of one!
Thank YOU! See you on THE GREAT LAKES! (I hope)
Thanks so much, Ted! I grew up in Illinois & Wisconsin, so I can’t wait to come home to the Great Lakes 😊
I should get a boat and just chill on the great lakes
I’m staying near the Great Lakes! Love it!
Thanks so much, Megan!!! Can’t wait to get back to my Great Lakes 🩵😊
I was in great lakes last summer, when I make my stops, you can be one of them!💗
Visiting all the Great Lakes is on my bucket list.

They said I should be drinking not going to a museum smh. Back in 2019 I went to Minneapolis. And one of my friends asked what’s out there? I said it’s on my bucket list to visit all the Great Lakes. Their response: “That’s whack.” 😒
Want a different vacation? Take a nine day boat journey on the Great Lakes!
